description: This file defines the BookingWebhookService class, which manages the emission and scheduling of webhooks related to booking events such as creation, cancellation, rescheduling, payment, no-shows, and meeting scheduling. It interacts with webhook notifiers, schedulers, and infrastructure components to handle webhook lifecycle and scheduling logic.

classes.name: BookingWebhookService
classes.description: A service class responsible for emitting and scheduling webhooks related to booking events, including creation, cancellation, rescheduling, payment, no-shows, and meeting events.

methods.name: emitBookingPaymentInitiated
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating that a booking payment has been initiated.

methods.name: emitBookingCreated
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating that a booking has been created.

methods.name: emitBookingCancelled
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating that a booking has been cancelled.

methods.name: emitBookingRequested
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating that a booking has been requested.

methods.name: emitBookingRescheduled
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating that a booking has been rescheduled.

methods.name: emitBookingPaid
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating that a booking has been paid.

methods.name: emitBookingNoShow
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating a no-show for a booking.

methods.name: emitBookingRejected
methods.description: Emits a webhook event indicating that a booking has been rejected.

methods.name: scheduleMeetingWebhooks
methods.description: Schedules webhooks for meeting start and end events related to a booking.

methods.name: cancelScheduledMeetingWebhooks
methods.description: Cancels scheduled meeting webhooks for a specific booking.

methods.name: scheduleNoShowWebhooks
methods.description: Schedules no-show related webhooks for hosts and guests.
